name: game-on
description: Game-On: quick browser games with server-verified scores

scripts.test: cd backend && go vet ./... && go test ./... && cd ../frontend && bun test
scripts.lint: bun --cwd frontend lint && cd backend && gofmt -l . && go vet ./...
scripts.build: bun --cwd frontend run build && cd backend && go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o ../bin/server ./cmd/server
